body: FYI for STORY-1888 (#2832, head 5d2a301): CI lib-0 and Build are FAILING. bug_1723_config_trust_tests reports 'aida-cli-lib/src/mandate_gates.rs: 6 config.toml site(s) found, inventory says 4'.
